stickers.name: Chevrons
stickers.css: .c1{animation:c1k 1.2s ease-in-out 0.2s infinite}@keyframes c1k{0%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:translateX(0)}40%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(6px)}}.c2{animation:c2k 1.2s ease-in-out 0.4s infinite}@keyframes c2k{0%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:translateX(0)}40%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(6px)}}.c3{animation:c3k 1.2s ease-in-out 0.6s infinite}@keyframes c3k{0%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:translateX(0)}40%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(6px)}}

stickers.name: Typing
stickers.css: .d0{animation:d0k 1.2s ease-in-out 0s infinite}@keyframes d0k{0%,60%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.5}30%{transform:translateY(-10px);opacity:1}}.d1{animation:d1k 1.2s ease-in-out 0.18s infinite}@keyframes d1k{0%,60%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.5}30%{transform:translateY(-10px);opacity:1}}.d2{animation:d2k 1.2s ease-in-out 0.36s infinite}@keyframes d2k{0%,60%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.5}30%{transform:translateY(-10px);opacity:1}}

stickers.name: Yay! bubble
stickers.css: .s0{animation:s0k 1.8s ease-in-out 0s infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%}@keyframes s0k{0%,100%{transform:scale(.4) rotate(0);opacity:.3}50%{transform:scale(1) rotate(45deg);opacity:1}}.s1{animation:s1k 1.8s ease-in-out 0.5s infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%}@keyframes s1k{0%,100%{transform:scale(.4) rotate(0);opacity:.3}50%{transform:scale(1) rotate(45deg);opacity:1}}.mv{animation:mvk 1.3s cubic-bezier(.3,0,.3,1) infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes mvk{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1.04,.96)}12%{transform:translateY(0) scale(.96,1.04)}45%{transform:translateY(-16px) scale(1,1)}80%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1.06,.94)}}
